nodes.name: source switching edge charge
nodes.description: Width-independent source charge delivered by switch-node/cascode turn-on dynamics.

attributes.summary: The PMOS source branch delivered 0.281 pC of fitted edge charge versus 0.037 pC for the sink; the switch/feed group dominates the source term.

nodes.name: switch/feed compliance headroom
nodes.description: Larger PMOS switch/feed sizing preserves current flatness across VCP but increases switching charge.

attributes.summary: Shrinking the switch/feed group fixed mismatch in G2 but reduced compliance span below the TT row.

nodes.name: partial edge collection
nodes.description: Sub-nanosecond activations sample the steep portion of source edge charge.

attributes.summary: At-lock local dQ/dDelta-t is about 270 uA, not the 48.8 uA DC or 70.8 uA 10-ns pulse-average current.

nodes.name: linear-through-zero threshold identity
nodes.description: For a linear-through-zero response the threshold-window width is approximately twice threshold divided by gain.

attributes.summary: width approximately 2*(0.05*Qnom)/local dQ/dDelta-t; the row is a gain proxy rather than an independent plateau width.

nodes.name: PFD/CP switching asymmetry
nodes.description: Edge-charge and switching asymmetry produces the static timing offset.

attributes.summary: Offset stayed 187-188 ps between VCP 0.6 V and 0.81 V despite different DC mismatch, excluding DC mismatch as the driver.

nodes.name: design-specific loop gain
nodes.description: The fine timing-transfer slope of this design is the linear-loop Icp binding.

attributes.summary: Higher local charge gain raises unity frequency and, with the fixed paper loop filter, lowers phase margin.

nodes.name: joint loop-filter pole/zero shaping
nodes.description: Coupled R1/R2/C1/C2 changes reshape unity frequency and phase margin.

attributes.summary: The LF-E joint redesign raised G3 phase margin from about 21 degrees with the paper filter to 69.4 degrees.

nodes.name: switch/feed edge-charge versus compliance
nodes.description: The same switch/feed sizing controls edge charge and compliance headroom in opposing specification directions.

attributes.summary: G2 achieved 10.1-percent mismatch but only 0.790 V span; G3 balanced 14.5 percent and 0.825 V.

nodes.name: tank loading
nodes.description: Cross-coupled device width adds tank loading while also changing negative resistance.

attributes.summary: Jointly doubling core widths shifted lock-point frequency down by a source-reported 89 MHz.

nodes.name: regeneration startup margin
nodes.description: Cross-coupled core strength controls buildup time.

attributes.summary: Jointly halving core widths slowed startup from 6.9 ns to 12.4 ns, about 1.8 times.

nodes.name: tail bias amplitude-power coupling
nodes.description: Tail current jointly controls power, steady swing, and startup margin.

attributes.summary: Halving tail width reduced power from 836 to 405 uW but swing from 1.624 to 0.640 V and slowed startup about four times.

nodes.name: supply pushing
nodes.description: Oscillation frequency falls with increased supply around the lock control point.

attributes.summary: Measured slope was approximately -120 MHz/V at ctrl=0.81 V.

nodes.name: PVT frequency shift
nodes.description: Process, temperature, and supply jointly shift the VCO frequency range.

attributes.summary: The public table reports an aggregate +56 MHz FF shift and -49 MHz historical SS/40 C shift without defining a more precise aggregation basis.

nodes.name: svaricap dsubw temperature-law failure
nodes.description: Default diode temperature scaling drives VJ through zero and makes depletion charge evaluate log of a negative number.

attributes.summary: VJ=0.1 with no TLEVC reaches zero at 52.46980 C; an exercised biased branch then produces NaN in transient.

nodes.name: pulse mismatch versus compliance span
nodes.description: PMOS switch/feed shrinkage reduces edge-charge mismatch but costs compliance headroom.

attributes.summary: G2 fixed mismatch and broke span; G3 balanced both rows.

nodes.name: amplitude and startup versus supply power
nodes.description: Tail starvation saves power while collapsing swing and startup margin.

attributes.summary: The T3 tail-width trial is a measured antagonistic coupling, not a textbook-only expectation.

attributes.predicate: exactly one monotone sign change; local R2 >= 0.98; qnet16/qnet8 per-cycle disagreement < 3 fC

nodes.name: behavioral closed-loop lock
nodes.description: Scored validity gate, not a phase-margin substitute.

attributes.predicate: ctrl drift <5 mV, late ripple <100 mV and growth <1.2, ctrl remains 0.1-1.1 V, divided frequency within 0.5 percent of 40 MHz

nodes.name: svaricap transient model validity
nodes.description: Blocks hot-corner VCO interpretation unless the exact dsubw model state is known and valid for the exercised bias.

attributes.predicate: unpatched hot biased dsubw evidence is invalid; patched points are usable only within recorded validation

nodes.name: DC current predicts delivered charge
nodes.description: DC-only characterization hides switching edge charge.

attributes.claim: DC pump current is the delivered-charge current relevant to switching.
attributes.correction: At VCP=0.6 V the source pulse-average current is about 45 percent above DC because of edge charge.

nodes.name: dead-zone width is an independent plateau knob
nodes.description: The public response is linear through zero rather than a plateau.

attributes.claim: The threshold-window width can be tuned independently of local gain.
attributes.correction: For linear-through-zero designs the ruled width is structurally about twice threshold divided by local gain.

nodes.name: DC mismatch causes static offset
nodes.description: The corrected remeasurement excludes DC mismatch as the driver.

attributes.claim: Static timing offset follows DC source/sink mismatch.
attributes.correction: Offset is VCP-independent and switching/edge-charge-asymmetry driven.

nodes.name: behavioral lock proves healthy phase margin
nodes.description: A low-phase-margin loop can still pass the lock gate.

attributes.claim: Clean behavioral lock establishes adequate phase margin.
attributes.correction: The reference locks with about 20 degrees phase margin; lock is a validity gate, while linear metrics assess loop health.

nodes.name: more gm is free
nodes.description: Core widening improves strength without an assumed tank cost.

attributes.claim: Increasing cross-coupled width is a free startup-strength improvement.
attributes.correction: Joint width x2 loaded the tank and shifted frequency down by 89 MHz.

nodes.name: tail starvation is free power saving
nodes.description: Power reduction hides swing and startup collapse.

attributes.claim: Tail width can be reduced to save power without another scored cost.
attributes.correction: Tail width x0.5 halved power but reduced swing to 0.640 V and slowed startup about four times.

nodes.name: hot failure is generic backend fragility
nodes.description: The failure was traced to one compact-model temperature law.

attributes.claim: Hot VCO transient failure is an unexplained mosvar/backend convergence problem.
attributes.correction: The native dsubw diode VJ law crosses zero; tlevc=1 on both cards repairs the bounded failure.
